help.goal: Everyone hunts words in the same grid of letters at the same time. A word only scores if nobody else wrote it too.
steps: Tap a letter to start a word, then keep tapping letters that touch the last one — sideways, up, down or diagonally.
You cannot use the same tile twice in one word.
Tap ✓ to hand the word in, ⌫ to take back the last letter.
Keep going until the clock runs out, then read the results.
notes: Scoring by length: 3 or 4 letters is 1 point, 5 is 2, 6 is 3, 7 is 5, 8 or more is 11.
Three letters is the minimum on the 4×4 board; the big 5×5 board wants four, the way Big Boggle is played.
Any word two or more players found is struck out for BOTH of them — the obvious words are worth nothing, so go long and go odd.
The Qu tile is two letters at once: QUIT is three taps and a four-letter word.
Your list is yours alone until the whistle. Other players only ever see how many words you have.
Alone, you play the board itself — the results screen tells you how many of its points you found.
